mapper.select: SELECT department.id FROM sys_dept department WHERE (department.id = #{deptId} OR FIND_IN_SET(#{deptId}, department.ancestors)) AND department.deleted = 0 AND department.status = 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept ancestor WHERE FIND_IN_SET(ancestor.id, department.ancestors) AND (ancestor.deleted != 0 OR ancestor.status = 1) )
